main.bio: Senior cybersecurity engineer who builds the security platforms other teams depend on. Creator and owner of Fiserv's enterprise-wide cybersecurity analytics platform — the primary security reporting tool for one of the world's largest fintechs, serving 200+ daily active users. I blend security architecture, vulnerability management, and risk mitigation with full ownership of the secure SDLC: cloud-native design on GCP, Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD automation, RBAC and secure data handling, and production AI/agentic systems. Proven at translating complex security data into decision-ready insight for technical and executive audiences.

resume.skillmessage: Core competencies I apply in production, at scale, every day:

education.degree: B.S. Electrical & Computer Engineering, Business Minor
education.description: Summa Cum Laude, Honors Research Distinction

description.bullet: - Conceived, architected, and own the enterprise's primary cybersecurity metrics & analytics platform — adopted company-wide as the authoritative source of security reporting, with 200+ daily active users, thousands of daily pageviews, and thousands of monthly unique users across security, engineering, and leadership

- Own the full secure SDLC: full-stack build in Node.js, Express, and React, containerized with Docker & Kubernetes and provisioned via Terraform (IaC), deployed on Google Cloud through GitLab CI/CD pipelines — delivered within Agile/Scrum ceremonies
- Serve as architecture SME for a second enterprise application (Next.js on GCP), leading security and architecture design reviews and guiding scalable, secure design decisions

- Drive vulnerability management and remediation tracking — triaging findings from vulnerability scanners (Wiz, Snyk, Qualys, Rapid7) and SIEM / log platforms (Splunk, Chronicle, Elastic), and partnering with engineering teams to prioritize and close risk

- Integrated production AI/LLM features into security applications, and apply deep command of cybersecurity concepts and risk mitigation to turn raw telemetry into reporting that drives remediation priorities and executive decision-making

- Built and operate a secure file-sharing and AI document-analysis platform for equity-advising firms and their clients — AI-driven scanning, grading, and automated report generation over sensitive financial documentation
- Engineered security-first: role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege design, and encrypted storage on Google Cloud Storage; grew to multiple paying clients at $1,000+ MRR

- Co-created an agentic AI platform of 30 specialist agents across 5 business suites (Revenue, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Operations), each with a leader agent, specialist roster, and tiered SaaS pricing

- Designed for enterprise trust: human-in-the-loop approval workflows, 100% audit-logged actions, and on-demand or scheduled execution with real-time run visibility — shipped rapidly on GCP Cloud Run using AI-assisted development (Claude Code)
- Drafted several patent applications for inventions utilizing groundbreaking technologies in the following fields: semiconductor device structure/fabrication and broadband cellular networking (5G)
- Maximized effectiveness of patent protection by drafting detailed yet broad claims
- Conducted effective interviews with USPTO Patent Examiners to expedite application allowance
- Prepared several responses to communications received from the USPTO, such as office actions and appeal briefs
- Collaborated with in-house patent counsel for Fortune 500 companies, both in the US and abroad
- Oversaw firmwide database outlining expected days of work and expected billings to optimize work item allocation
- Strategized and developed several Microsoft Office VBA macros for automating various aspects of patent prosecution
- Developed applications for organizing/displaying automated testing results and kept detailed documentation
- Built frontend UI in Vue.js and fetched test results from AWS S3 Buckets in backend using Java and Spring Boot
- Utilized Git for version control and created a build and deploy plan to ensure CI/CD pipeline was followed
- Maintained and updated company hotlinks page using Angular and TypeScript
- Worked alongside Scrum Master and Architects to lead scrum team through daily agile ceremonies
- Automated large-scale server processes by writing reusable scripts in PowerShell, saving months of brute-force labor
- Built, maintained, and decommissioned servers using tools such as VMWare, SCOM, SCCM, AD, and DNS
- Managed endpoint security and incident response programs on servers for PCI compliance purposes
- Led a team in charge of imaging thousands of new PCs, and delivered them to their respective schools
- Assisted with technological issues on a large district-wide scale through daily interactive support
- -Provided maintenance on projectors, printers, PCs, and a variety of other hardware
- Performed genetic research specializing in pediatric neuromuscular disease therapies
- Conducted research and presented findings to members of the research community

- Co-authored abstract on “Exon skipping of the toxic DUX4 gene as a promising therapeutic approach for Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy” which was presented to the American Society of Gene and Cell Therapy

- Co-authored a paper featured on nature.com - 'Human miRNA miR-675 inhibits DUX4 expression and may be exploited as a potential treatment forFacioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy 2021 Dec 8; https://rdcu.be/cItMx'
- Received 1st place in annual 2015 Nationwide Children's Research Poster Competition
